correctness.rationale: For every odd q and nonzero t, the nondegenerate conic has k=q-chi_q(-1) points; distinct translated conics meet in at most two points. Reflection c -> a+b-c exhausts the possible centers for a pair, with uniqueness exactly for antipodal pairs. This proves the pair criterion; a triple has all eight traces exactly when it lies on a circle, avoids antipodal pairs, and k>=8. q=3,5 have k=4 and every triple on a circle has an antipodal pair. Uniqueness of circles through three points excludes four-point shattering. Summation over q^2 centers gives exact coefficients; every inequality and small boundary is checked in RESULT.md. Independent bitset enumeration of all traces covers all nonzero t for q=3,5,7,9 and t=1 for q=11,13. Finite tests supplement, not replace, the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The exact all-field full shattering-complex face vector is a natural invariant of finite-field distance incidence: pair/triple counts and support geometry cannot be recovered from a scalar VC dimension.
